title: Al-Mabsut
author: as-sarakhsi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Sarakhsi's expansive commentary on the Hanafi law of worship, transactions, family, inheritance and procedure. Each question is stated, traced to its authorities, argued through the disagreements of the school, and followed by the reasoning that settles it, making the work a record of Hanafi legal argument at its most detailed.
historicalContext: Al-Sarakhsi dictated much of the Mabsut while imprisoned in Uzkand, from materials his students brought him. The work became a central reference for later Hanafi jurists and preserves earlier Hanafi texts and opinions that would otherwise be lost.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
